units.source_text: 名人只用五分钟，白102冲，与黑对抗。

en.t: The Master used only five minutes, then White 102 thrust forward to confront Black.

units.source_text: 七段下黑105，又思考了四十二分钟。

en.t: The seventh dan played Black 105, after thinking for another forty-two minutes.

units.source_text: 在伊东的头一天，只下了五手，黑105封盘。

en.t: On the first day in Ito, only five moves were played, and Black 105 was sealed.
